text:
Nia: dropping a compact-compare sketch. focus: filter collapse UX, pin indicator clarity, and perf badge readability in dark theme. figma: https://figma.redwood/compact-compare-2 :mag:

Owen: Inline collapse feels better than a flyout. keeps filters visible. Suggest showing the first two active chips + a 'Show 2 filters' control that expands inline. Make sure the control has aria-expanded.

Priya: For pin semantics: prefer making pinning explicit in URL for MVP so share links include pins. later add backend sync. Also show tiny 'Pinned' label on model cards.

Luis: Perf badges: add an icon (clock/lightning) left of the stat and increase font-weight for numbers so contrast issues are less likely. For dark theme, add a 1px white overlay at 8% opacity rather than changing core color.

A11yBot: Checklist: badges need aria-labels (e.g. "latency 120ms, p95"). collapsed filter control must have aria-controls and aria-expanded. pin button must be reachable via keyboard and announce state changes to SR.

Nia: Copy: change "+2" -> "Show 2 filters" (clearer). Tooltip for pin: "Pin this version to the compare (persists in this browser)" while backend-less. Add undo snackbar on unpin.

Owen: Microinteraction: animate pin -> label fade (120ms) so users see the mapping. keep animation reduced-motion friendly.

Priya: I'll update figma with the label and tooltip copy. Owen, can you prototype the inline expand + keyboard flow? Luis, can you mock badge variants for dark mode? I'll collect PR sketches for URL encoding format tomorrow.

Owen: On it  will add a gif by EOD.

Luis: will push color variants to the design file.

Nia: Thanks all, booking a 20m sync tomorrow. @Owen @Priya @Luis
